# Play — Product Placement

- SudokuPad: [Product Placement on SudokuPad](https://sudokupad.)
- f-puzzles: [Product Placement on f-puzzles](https://www.f-puzzles.com/?)

Both links carry the same f-puzzles JSON (lz-string compressed) including the solution, so SudokuPad can check your answer.
Bridges are an invented rule, so no app knows them. They are exported as cosmetic teal lines with a pale circle at each end,
and no app will enforce the product = sum rule: the rules text is the authority. SudokuPad still checks your finished grid
against the embedded solution.
Fallback: `puzzle.json` in this folder is the machine-readable source (givens, constraints, solution).
